title: ContractReceived
description: A new contract requiring review, delivered to the contract review agent.

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for this contract in the CLM system.

document_path.description: Path to the contract document within the /workspace/contracts mount.

review_instructions.description: Optional specific review instructions from the requesting team.

review_deadline.description: ISO 8601 deadline by which the review must be complete.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the contract was received.
